coordinate_system: glTF/three.js local model coords, Y-up, relative to GLB root
method: Positions derived from GLB vertex data: vertex slab at the extreme plane along the mate direction, centroid projected onto that plane (no hand-typed coordinates). Sizes default to the minimum perpendicular bbox extent of the cited node (nominal interface diameter) and are overridden for working envelopes. kind/role follow component-contracts.json port ids; contract-standard vs geometry mismatches are recorded in note and never silently resolved.
